title_zh: 高校赛事信息可视化方案策略与视觉呈现训练集
title_en: College Competition Information Visualization Strategy and Presentation Boards
source_collection: User-provided university competition, China Good Creative, and New Quality Point award reference images
commercial_separation_rule: Treat this batch as academic competition and cultural research work. Do not use commercial conversion, retail campaign, packaging hero shot, or generic advertising logic unless the user explicitly asks for adaptation.
user_training_note: User identified these references as a university competition information-visualization strategy and visual-presentation training batch. The repository stores captions, manifests, strategy notes, and quality reviews; image files remain local and ignored by git until rights and training permission are cleared.

design_dna.visual_positioning: Research-led university competition boards that transform cultural material, craft processes, regional history, maps, timelines, charts, and application proofs into a coherent information-visualization system.
context_difference_from_commercial_work: goal is to prove research value and design logic, not to sell a product
dense information is acceptable only when a visible reading order, module names, spacing, and hierarchy are locked
visual spectacle must be tied to evidence, taxonomy, timeline, map, process, or application proof
exact Chinese copy requires source text; micro labels are structural placeholders during prompt generation
strategy_layers: dominant visual anchor such as a ritual wheel, isometric process island, map, or data structure
evidence modules including timeline, taxonomy, maps, charts, icon inventories, source references, and process steps
application proof including poster series, web or spatial display, product mockup, exhibition board or public media scenario

substyle_clusters.role: For intangible heritage, zodiac, ritual, mask, mythology, pattern and historical evolution topics.
substyle_clusters.composition: dark field, luminous title, radial wheel or calendar anchor, taxonomy cards, source callouts, pattern reference chart, bottom timeline.
substyle_clusters.palette: deep purple or black, luminous gold, muted pastel illustration inserts, restrained red or blue highlights.

substyle_clusters.role: For craft, production, science, tourism and educational process topics such as tea making.
substyle_clusters.composition: white or blue frame, central isometric process landscape, numbered callouts, side technical diagrams, plant/material analysis, application display board.
substyle_clusters.palette: blue, teal, green, white, light gradient, limited warm highlights.

substyle_clusters.role: For heritage plus technology, route systems, installation proof or high-density chart display.
substyle_clusters.composition: dark background, specification row, chart strip, map or route diagram, result rendering and poster application display.
substyle_clusters.palette: black, deep blue, muted peach, pale blue, white label accents.

anti_fragmentation_rules: start prompts with project context: academic-discipline-competition and information visualization
define one dominant anchor before listing submodules
group dense information into named modules with margins and clear labels
do not use cultural motifs as loose decoration; assign each motif to taxonomy, timeline, map, process, pattern or application proof
exclude watermarks, social-media overlays, unverified award badges and creator marks
require verified source copy for body text, maps, charts, and bilingual captions

prompt_packet_bias.density_policy: high-evidence-density with explicit grid and reading path
prompt_packet_bias.text_policy: exact large titles when supplied; placeholder blocks for microcopy until source text is verified
